subject: Erika Reinfeld School Committee Re-election Interview
overview: School Committee incumbent Erika Reinfeld discussed her first-term record, her vision for future academic offerings, and the process for appointing a permanent superintendent. She emphasized her work on the school budget override and student distribution policies.

items.title: Guest Introduction and Favorite Local Eatery
items.summary: Erika Reinfeld introduced herself as a first-term incumbent running for re-election to the Medford School Committee.

items.title: First-Term Accomplishments and Learning Curve
items.summary: Reinfeld reflected on her first term, citing her work on elementary school space assessments, the creation of an after-school task force, and the passage of the budget override.

items.title: Defining the Scope of the School Committee
items.summary: The discussion distinguished the committee's legal role in budget and policy from its informal role as a liaison between families and the school administration.

items.title: Priorities for a Potential Second Term
items.summary: Priorities for a second term include ensuring follow-through on new curricula and schedules, protecting students from federal policy shifts, and enhancing support for diverse learning styles.

items.title: Superintendent Search and Strategic Planning
items.summary: Reinfeld addressed the committee's discretion in hiring a permanent superintendent and the need for community input to inform the current interim leadership transition.

items.title: Data-Driven Decision Making and Assessment
items.summary: The guest discussed balancing quantitative data from standardized testing with qualitative narratives to track student progress and school climate.

items.title: Affirming Community Values and Closing Remarks
items.summary: Reinfeld concluded by emphasizing her commitment to making all students feel they belong in Medford schools and inviting continued community dialogue.
